Prices for the stay of Nov 2 to 4, 2026, as listed on September 28, 2026.

18 Cancun hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Cancun hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Cancun hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 3, Billabook.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1, klook at 1, Museo Casa Turquesa at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Cancun rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 16 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Cancun hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 23% ($45 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Hotel Casa Turquesa to 29% at Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
